title: Battle of Gorjani
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Gorjani", at revision 1370441843, opens: "The Battle of Gorjani or Battle of Đakovo was fought on 9 October 1537 at Gorjani, a place in Slavonia, between the towns of Đakovo and Valpovo, as part of the Little War in Hungary as well as the Hundred Years' Croatian–Ottoman War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q904938, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1537 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
